mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AND COALESCE(BOOL_AND(child.quantity = #{gross} AND child.currency_id = #{currencyId}), false) FROM transaction child JOIN transaction_event outcome ON outcome.transaction_id = child.transaction_id WHERE child.parent_transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId} AND child.transaction_type_id = (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'CAPTURE') AND outcome.transaction_event_type_id = (SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event_type WHERE code = 'CAPTURED')

SELECT psp_register.account_id AS "pspAccountId", psp_line.register_id AS "pspRegisterId", tax_register.account_id AS "taxAuthorityAccountId", tax_line.register_id AS "taxRegisterId", merchant_register.account_id AS "merchantAccountId", merchant_line.register_id AS "merchantRegisterId", psp_line.currency_id AS "currencyId" FROM transaction capture JOIN transaction_event captured ON captured.transaction_id = capture.transaction_id AND captured.transaction_event_type_id = (SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event_type WHERE code = 'CAPTURED') JOIN journal_entry entry ON entry.transaction_event_id = captured.transaction_event_id JOIN journal_entry_type entry_type ON entry_type.journal_entry_type_id = entry.journal_entry_type_id AND entry_type.code = 'CAPTURE' JOIN journal_entry_line psp_line ON psp_line.journal_entry_id = entry.journal_entry_id JOIN register psp_register ON psp_register.register_id = psp_line.register_id JOIN register_type psp_type ON psp_type.register_type_id = psp_register.register_type_id AND psp_type.register_type_code = 'PSP_RECEIVABLE' JOIN journal_entry_line tax_line ON tax_line.journal_entry_id = entry.journal_entry_id JOIN register tax_register ON tax_register.register_id = tax_line.register_id JOIN register_type tax_type ON tax_type.register_type_id = tax_register.register_type_id AND tax_type.register_type_code = 'TAX_PAYABLE' JOIN journal_entry_line merchant_line ON merchant_line.journal_entry_id = entry.journal_entry_id JOIN register merchant_register ON merchant_register.register_id = merchant_line.register_id JOIN register_type merchant_type ON merchant_type.register_type_id = merchant_register.register_type_id AND merchant_type.register_type_code = 'MERCHANT_PAYABLE' WHERE capture.parent_transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId} AND capture.transaction_type_id = (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'CAPTURE')

SELECT child.transaction_id AS "transactionId", child.parent_transaction_id AS "paymentTransactionId", child.reference AS "reference", child.quantity AS "quantity", child.currency_id AS "currencyId", detail.net_quantity AS "netQuantity", detail.tax_quantity AS "taxQuantity", child.created_ts AS "createdTs", outcome.transaction_event_type_id AS "eventTypeId" FROM transaction child JOIN refund_detail detail ON detail.transaction_id = child.transaction_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event WHERE transaction_id = child.transaction_id ORDER BY transaction_event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) outcome ON true WHERE child.parent_transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId} AND child.transaction_type_id = (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'REFUND') ORDER BY child.transaction_id

SELECT child.transaction_id AS "transactionId", child.parent_transaction_id AS "paymentTransactionId", child.reference AS "reference", child.quantity AS "quantity", child.currency_id AS "currencyId", detail.net_quantity AS "netQuantity", detail.tax_quantity AS "taxQuantity", child.created_ts AS "createdTs", outcome.transaction_event_type_id AS "eventTypeId" FROM transaction child JOIN refund_detail detail ON detail.transaction_id = child.transaction_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event WHERE transaction_id = child.transaction_id ORDER BY transaction_event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) outcome ON true WHERE child.reference = #{reference} AND child.transaction_type_id = (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'REFUND')

INSERT INTO transaction (transaction_type_id, parent_transaction_id, account_id, reference, quantity, currency_id, created_ts) VALUES ((SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'REFUND'), #{paymentTransactionId},#{merchantAccountId},#{reference},#{gross},#{currencyId}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (reference) DO NOTHING RETURNING transaction_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_detail (transaction_id, transaction_type_id, net_quantity, tax_quantity) VALUES (#{transactionId}, (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'REFUND'), #{net},#{tax})
